primary_sources.name: Livshyts--Paouris--Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures
primary_sources.use: k-dimensional orthogonal marginal of a genuine cap-one product density has density at most 2^(k/2)

primary_sources.name: Rudelson--Vershynin, Small ball probabilities for linear images of high dimensional distributions
primary_sources.use: unit scalar linear form of independent cap-one coordinates has density at most sqrt(2)

partner_results_applied.inequality: for singleton original scalar square and physical cross B: ||p_Q||inf <=4 sqrt(2)/(|a| sigma_1(B))^(1/2)

new_result.statement: For an original-coordinate retained block with A_II=0, A_Iw=0, arbitrary A_JJ and A_Jw, and arbitrary outside couplings after original-coordinate conditioning, ||p_Q||inf <= min{2 sqrt(pi)/(sigma_1 sigma_2)^(1/2), 4 sqrt(2)/(|A_ww| sigma_1)^(1/2)} in their respective valid scopes.
new_result.target_family: |I|=2, rank-two B_t with singular values {1,t}, scalar A_ww=t^-1. Retained nonzero spectrum {1,-1,t,-t,t^-1}; for every t>0 at least three eigenvalues have modulus >=1.
new_result.continuity: C_0 proved for standalone target family; general ambient fusion asserted only as essential boundedness

unresolved_implication: From bare s_3(A)>=1, force a product-preserving packet with A_II=0, A_Iw=0 and max{sigma_1 sigma_2, |A_ww| sigma_1} bounded below, or route failure into a paid physical-pair/grouped-hub/ridge/product-Fourier branch. The hard survivor has nonzero curvature on the would-be zero-self side or unavoidable I-w source entanglement with effectively rank-one crossing.
next_step: Attack the source-entangled I-w/nonzero-self-side survivor with a dependence-safe receiver rather than deleting the small crossing tail.
